12 months contract - role for UiPath via Flow Automations – Hybrid in Bucharest 
 Flow Automations, a strategic partner of UiPath, is hiring an RPA Business Analyst to support UiPath’s enterprise automation initiatives.
 At UiPath — the world’s leading automation company and Romania’s top tech success story — you will help redefine automation through Agentic AI, intelligent document processing, and containerized workflows that transform how enterprises operate.
 This role is focused on business analysis and solution design for enterprise-grade automation programs. You’ll collaborate closely with UiPath delivery teams, align business requirements with technical feasibility, and ensure high-quality automation solutions are delivered for some of the largest organizations in Europe.
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Process Discovery & Analysis: Engage with stakeholders to gather requirements from an RPA perspective, assess process complexity, and identify automation opportunities.
 Documentation: Create process maps (current & future state), workflow diagrams, and detailed documentation using Visio or similar tools. Maintain Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM).
 Solution Design: Define functional requirements, integration parameters, and business cases (including ROI calculations) to support automation initiatives.
 Collaboration: Work closely with developers, architects, and business teams to ensure smooth delivery and signoff of requirements.
 Quality & Governance: Follow defined templates, ensure stakeholder buy-in, and document signoffs for compliance.
 Continuous Improvement: Support innovation by integrating partner products like ABBYY and UiPath Document Understanding.
 What You Will Bring 
 Fluent French and English. 
 2+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Process Owner (Finance, Accounting, Insurance, HR, or ITO services).
 Minimum 1.5 years of BA experience on UiPath implementation projects.
Strong understanding of RPA technologies, process documentation, and automation lifecycles.
Hands-on experience with UiPath products (Studio, Orchestrator, Document Understanding, Task Capture).
Excellent logical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication abilities — both written and verbal — and stakeholder management skills.
Knowledge of ROI calculation and business case preparation.
Experience working with defined documentation templates and obtaining client signoff.
 Nice to Have 
UiPath Professional Certifications.
Exposure to AI-driven automation or intelligent document processing.
Industry experience in finance, manufacturing, or public sector.
Understanding of UiPath infrastructure and deployment requirements.
 Additional Information 
 At Flow Automations, we partner with enterprise clients and strategic partners like UiPath to deliver impactful automation and AI solutions at scale.
 This engagement offers the opportunity to work directly with UiPath — Romania’s most successful tech company and a global automation leader — on modern automation initiatives. Successful collaboration on this project can lead to extended engagements or future opportunities within ongoing UiPath programs, providing continuity beyond the initial contract.
